items.title: Internalizing Investment Mandates: A Neurosymbolic RL Approach to Portfolio Allocation
items.body: Institutional portfolios operate under investment policy statements that specify asset allocation constraints, often conditioned on market regime information. Deep reinforcement learning has been shown to optimize financial performance but typically does not enforce rule compliance, making it unsuitable for real-world deployment. Existing neurosymbolic methods such as Probabilistic Logic Policy Gradient (PLPG) offer constraint-satisfying reinforcement learning (RL) via differentiable symbolic supervision but assume a finite, discrete action space. We present a PLPG-inspired continuous allocation method that estimates the probability that the policy's own executed action satisfies the investment mandate, using reparameterized Monte Carlo sampling, and adds it to the training objective. No post-hoc enforcement mechanism intercepts actions at inference time and compliance is learned by the agent. Audited directly on deterministic mean actions with no correction, the policy reduces violations of a six-rule regime-conditional mandate from 96-98% for unconstrained RL and 33.4% for a reward-penalty baseline to 4.8%, showing that a continuous-action neurosymbolic policy can substantially internalize a symbolic mandate.
items.title_ko: 투자 목표 내재화: 신경-기호 강화 학습 기반 포트폴리오 할당
items.summary_ko: 기관 포트폴리오의 투자 목표를 준수하면서 재무 성과를 최적화하기 위해 신경-기호 강화 학습(Neurosymbolic RL) 접근 방식을 제안합니다. 기존 심층 강화 학습은 규칙 준수를 강제하지 못하는 문제를 해결하여 실제 배포에 적합하도록 합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 기반 금융 시스템이 실제 투자 환경의 복잡한 규칙과 규제를 준수하면서도 최적의 성과를 달성할 수 있도록 하는 중요한 연구로, 금융 AI의 신뢰성을 높일 수 있습니다.

items.title: AgentSSL: Can MLE Agents Leverage Unlabeled Data?
items.body: Applying machine learning systems to new domains introduces bottlenecks in both labeled data acquisition and manual pipeline engineering. While recent MLE agents show promise in automating pipeline design, they have been studied almost exclusively in fully supervised settings, leaving them untested in realistic regimes where labeled data is scarce but unlabeled data is abundant. In this work, we introduce Agentic Semi-Supervised Learning (AgentSSL), framing SSL as a program search problem and studying how agents navigate this space under limited supervision. We find that even under weak feedback and matched compute, agents can synthesize code that combines and adapts established SSL techniques, exceeding the strongest human-engineered baselines in 8 of 12 settings by up to +21.8%. However, our results identify program selection as a critical bottleneck in AgentSSL, where performance drops by as much as 47% when selecting based on the agent's feedback metric. To systematically study this bottleneck, we introduce ProgramSelectBench, a large-scale benchmark with a combined total of 16,977 agent-generated and human-engineered SSL programs, and evaluate both unsupervised and active program selection methods. We further evaluate AgentSSL on real-world ecology detection tasks, highlighting the opportunities and challenges of transferring agent-discovered strategies beyond controlled benchmarks.
items.title_ko: AgentSSL: MLE 에이전트가 레이블 없는 데이터를 활용할 수 있는가?
items.summary_ko: AgentSSL은 레이블이 부족하지만 레이블 없는 데이터가 풍부한 실제 상황에서 기계 학습 엔지니어링(MLE) 에이전트의 성능을 연구합니다. 반지도 학습(SSL)을 프로그램 탐색 문제로 재구성하고, MLE 에이전트가 파이프라인 설계를 자동화하여 레이블 없는 데이터를 활용하는 가능성을 탐구합니다.
items.why_ko: 레이블링 비용이 많이 드는 현실적인 데이터 환경에서 AI 모델을 효율적으로 개발하고 배포하는 데 필수적인 반지도 학습과 에이전트 기술의 결합 가능성을 탐구하여, 개발자들에게 실용적인 방향을 제시합니다.

items.title: Learning When Diffusion Language Models Should Regenerate
items.body: Remasking allows diffusion language models to revisit generated text, but effective correction requires knowing when and what to revise. Our diagnosis on Sudoku reveals two gaps. Hidden states contain error information that token confidence does not reliably expose, and remasking an isolated error usually reproduces it when the surrounding context remains fixed. These findings motivate DiVR , a verifier that predicts whether a partially generated sequence will reach a correct answer. Trained on the final correctness of the model's own trajectories, DiVR decides when to regenerate a block and which alternative to retain, while the generator itself stays unchanged. On five reasoning benchmarks with LLaDA-8B-Base, DiVR raises the average accuracy of the fine-tuned generator from 35.3\% to 43.4\% at $1.9$-$3.5\times$ the cost of greedy decoding, above search baselines that use $3.8$-$7.4\times$. It also complements post-training such as supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, and generalizes to other generators, including Dream.
items.title_ko: 확산 언어 모델이 언제 재생성해야 하는지 학습
items.summary_ko: 확산 언어 모델의 '재마스킹(remasking)' 기법을 통해 생성된 텍스트를 수정하는 연구로, 모델이 언제 그리고 무엇을 수정해야 효과적인지 탐구합니다. Sudoku 퍼즐을 통해 은닉 상태에 오류 정보가 포함되어 있지만, 토큰 신뢰도가 이를 안정적으로 노출하지 못하며, 고정된 주변 컨텍스트에서는 단일 오류를 재마스킹해도 오류가 재현되는 문제점을 발견했습니다. 이를 해결하기 위해 부분적으로 생성된 시퀀스가 올바른 답변에 도달할지 예측하는 검증기 DiVR을 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: 생성형 AI 모델의 출력 품질을 개선하고 오류를 효과적으로 수정하는 방법을 제시하여, 더욱 신뢰할 수 있는 언어 모델 개발에 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: CoReMem: Cost-Internalizing Memory for Successive Coding Tasks with Prospective Valuation
items.body: Coding agents tackle successive tasks on an evolving repository, carrying forward edits and writing memory before the next task is known. Selecting memory for unknown next tasks requires balancing future usefulness against the costs of writing and reading it. The actor must also decide when acting on available memory saves effort as the task unfolds. We introduce Coding-Repository Memory (CoReMem), a cost-internalizing framework that guides memory design and actor adaptation through measured memory value on the next task. Prospective segment valuation compares runs of the next task with and without individual trajectory segments from the same inherited repository state, guiding a compact memory built around anchors: repository locations and executable checks. Actor adaptation estimates on-policy memory value within rollout groups with and without memory, using a reward that prioritizes resolution and penalizes step count in successful runs. Provenance-gated value credit assigns the additional value term to steps identified as using memory-supplied anchors, while every step retains outcome credit. On ChainSWE, CoReMem raises the 27B actor's resolve rate from 21.0% to 25.7%, with 17% fewer steps and 11% fewer total cache-aware tokens, including memory-module calls, relative to the untrained actor model without memory.
items.title_ko: CoReMem: 잠재적 가치를 통한 연속 코딩 작업을 위한 비용 내재화 메모리
items.summary_ko: CoReMem(Coding-Repository Memory)은 진화하는 저장소에서 연속적인 코딩 작업을 수행하는 에이전트를 위한 비용 내재화 메모리 프레임워크입니다. 이 프레임워크는 메모리 작성 및 읽기 비용을 고려하여 미래의 유용성을 균형 있게 평가하고, 작업이 진행됨에 따라 사용 가능한 메모리를 언제 활용할지 결정하도록 돕습니다.
items.why_ko: AI 코딩 에이전트의 효율성과 자율성을 높이는 데 중요한 역할을 하는 메모리 관리 전략을 제시하여, 장기적인 소프트웨어 개발 프로젝트에서 AI의 실질적인 기여도를 향상시킬 수 있습니다.

items.title: Linking Rapid Learning to Compositional Structure in Neural Networks: Evidence from Additive Analogies in Meta-Learned Parameter Spaces
items.body: Humans can learn rapidly from limited experience, while neural networks typically require extensive training. In this work, we investigate what properties of a neural network can enable it to learn rapidly. We study neural networks that have been optimized via meta-learning, a technique that exposes a network to many related functions to facilitate its subsequent learning of similar functions. Prior work has shown that these meta-learned networks can learn new functions rapidly, but how they do so remains unclear. To investigate their internal structure, we take inspiration from classic work demonstrating additive relationships among the learned vectors that neural networks use to represent words (e.g., "king" minus "man" plus "woman" approximates "queen"). Analogously, we look for additive relationships among a meta-learned network's "representations" of different functions; when a meta-learned network rapidly learns to implement a specific function, all of its adapted parameter values can be concatenated into a single vector that we treat as representing the function. We find that such parameter vectors can be added and subtracted according to symbolic relationships among the functions they represent, yielding new parameter vectors that successfully represent the functions predicted by the corresponding symbolic manipulations: the networks specified by these artificially recombined vectors actually implement the intended functions without any direct training on them. Our results suggest that meta-learning can tune a network's starting point to organize subsequent learning along systematic, functionally meaningful trajectories through the space of possible parameter vectors, providing a geometric basis for realizing inductive biases in neural networks.
items.title_ko: 신경망의 빠른 학습과 구성적 구조 연결: 메타 학습된 파라미터 공간의 가산적 비유 증거
items.summary_ko: 제한된 경험으로 빠르게 학습하는 인간의 능력과 달리, 신경망은 일반적으로 광범위한 훈련을 필요로 합니다. 이 연구는 신경망이 빠르게 학습할 수 있도록 하는 속성을 조사하며, 메타 학습된 신경망이 어떻게 새로운 함수를 빠르게 학습하는지 분석합니다.
items.why_ko: 인간의 빠른 학습 능력을 모방하는 AI 시스템 개발에 중요한 통찰을 제공하며, 이는 적은 데이터로도 효율적으로 학습하는 AI 모델을 구축하는 데 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Sketching Language Models for Context Attribution
items.body:
Context attribution asks how removing parts of a prompt changes a language model's output. We study leave-one-out (LOO) attribution for a prompt of $n$ tokens and a fixed measurement function. Computing all LOO values directly requires $n$ model evaluations. Under a stability assumption, our algorithm estimates all LOO values to error proportional to $\varepsilon$ with constant probability using $O(\sqrt{\log(1/\varepsilon)}/\varepsilon)$ evaluation calls. To complement our upper bound, we prove a matching $Ω(\sqrt{\log(1/\varepsilon)}/\varepsilon)$ lower bound on the number of evaluation calls in an oracle model. Empirically, we verify coefficient decay consistent with stability and evaluate the performance of our sketching algorithm on a small language-model retrieval task.
Technically, our result is based on a sketching algorithm for arithmetic circuits whose Taylor coefficients satisfy the stability condition recently introduced by Gunn [Gun26]. A direct adaptation of their forward differentiation sketches would require $\widetilde{O}(\log(n)/\varepsilon^2)$ evaluation calls. Our key observation is that we can apply forward differentiation to the backpropagation circuit, with only constant overhead over a forward sketch of the same Taylor degree. This reduces the variance of the sketches and is key to our improved evaluation bound. Our lower bound builds on the techniques of Amsel, Chen, Duman Keles, Halikias, Musco, and Musco [ACDH+26, SIAM Journal on Matrix Analysis and Applications] for lower bounding the number of matrix-vector queries to estimate the diagonal elements of random matrices.
items.title_ko: 컨텍스트 귀속을 위한 스케칭 언어 모델
items.summary_ko: 컨텍스트 귀속(Context attribution)은 프롬프트의 일부를 제거했을 때 언어 모델 출력에 어떤 변화가 생기는지 분석하는 기법입니다. 이 연구는 leave-one-out (LOO) 귀속 방법을 사용하여 $n$개의 토큰 프롬프트에 대해 모든 LOO 값을 효율적으로 추정하는 알고리즘을 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM의 출력에 대한 특정 프롬프트 요소의 영향을 이해하는 데 필수적인 기술로, 모델의 해석 가능성을 높이고, 프롬프트 엔지니어링 전략을 개선하는 데 실질적인 도움을 줄 수 있습니다.

items.title: Classical Energies Learn to Reason 1,000x Faster than Looped Models
items.body: Looped models have emerged as a prominent paradigm for reasoning, with successes on simple reasoning puzzles such as Sudoku-Extreme and Maze-Unique. However, these models can be unstable, slow to train, and use many parameters and FLOPs to solve simple puzzles. Descent on an energy not only mitigates these issues but also offers advantages: built-in early stopping, compute that adapts to problem difficulty, fast training without differentiating through a solver, and interpretable weights that learn the constraints of the puzzle. Here we demonstrate this with a learned version of Hopfield & Tank's energy from the 80s, which we term CRAM, solves 99.996% of Sudoku-Extreme and 100% of Maze-Unique test puzzles after 42 ms and 132 ms of training on one GPU, at least 1,000x faster than looped models on these tasks. CRAM also matches baseline looped models at their highest accuracy on Sudoku-Extreme using at least 282x fewer inference FLOPs. Our work suggests two things. First, that energies are an extremely promising direction for training reasoning from data. Second, a caution against using trivially solvable benchmarks like Sudoku and Maze to test the scalability of looped reasoning techniques.
items.body_ko: 반복 모델은 Sudoku-Extreme 및 Maze-Unique와 같은 간단한 추론 퍼즐에서 성공을 거두며 추론을 위한 탁월한 패러다임으로 부상했습니다. 그러나 이러한 모델은 불안정하고 학습 속도가 느리며 간단한 퍼즐을 해결하는 데 많은 매개변수와 FLOP를 사용합니다. 에너지에 대한 경사 하강법은 이러한 문제를 완화할 뿐만 아니라 내장된 조기 중단, 문제 난이도에 따라 조정되는 계산, 솔버를 통한 미분 없이 빠른 학습, 퍼즐의 제약 조건을 학습하는 해석 가능한 가중치 등 여러 장점을 제공합니다. 여기에서는 80년대 Hopfield & Tank의 에너지 학습 버전을 CRAM이라고 부르며 이를 시연합니다. CRAM은 단일 GPU에서 42ms 및 132ms 학습 후 Sudoku-Extreme의 99.996%와 Maze-Unique 테스트 퍼즐의 100%를 해결하며, 이는 이러한 작업에서 반복 모델보다 최소 1,000배 빠릅니다. CRAM은 또한 Sudoku-Extreme에서 최소 282배 적은 추론 FLOP를 사용하여 가장 높은 정확도로 기준 반복 모델과 일치합니다. 우리의 작업은 두 가지를 시사합니다. 첫째, 에너지는 데이터로부터 추론을 학습하는 데 매우 유망한 방향입니다. 둘째, Sudoku 및 Maze와 같이 사소하게 해결 가능한 벤치마크를 사용하여 반복 추론 기술의 확장성을 테스트하는 것에 대한 주의입니다.
items.title_ko: 고전 에너지 모델, 반복 모델보다 1,000배 빠르게 추론 학습
items.summary_ko: 고전 에너지 모델(Classical Energies)이 Sudoku-Extreme 및 Maze-Unique와 같은 간단한 추론 퍼즐에서 반복 모델(Looped Models)보다 1,000배 빠르게 추론을 학습할 수 있음을 보여줍니다. 이 모델은 안정성이 높고 훈련 속도가 빠르며, 적은 파라미터와 FLOPs로도 문제를 해결할 수 있습니다.
items.why_ko: AI 추론 모델의 효율성과 안정성을 혁신적으로 개선할 수 있는 새로운 접근 방식을 제시하여, 복잡한 문제 해결을 위한 AI 시스템 개발에 큰 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다.

items.title: Quantifying structural stability of transparent models for general insurance pricing
items.body: The short duration of general insurance contracts leads to rapid distributional shifts in the data, warranting regular model updates. This process may yield a post-update model that differs considerably from the pre-update model in both predictions and structure. Structural stability is upstream of predictive stability, yet existing structural stability metrics are mostly restricted to simple decision trees. Thus, we first introduce the notion of functional transparency, characterising models with a prediction function that can be expressed as a sum of univariate functions for main effects and bivariate functions for pairwise interactions. Then, we propose the Mean Squared Shape function distance, a metric to quantify the structural stability of functionally transparent models, which are particularly relevant in actuarial science. Using three public auto insurance datasets, we present a benchmark study to demonstrate the usefulness of our metric in identifying a stable and accurate transparent model. Generalised linear models with centred numerical covariates are stable, and explainable boosting machines (EBMs) offer a compromise between stability and performance. We also find that stabilisation strategies, such as sequential modelling and fixed hyperparameters, can substantially improve stability for both EBM and XGBoost models, with negligible impact on performance.
items.title_ko: 일반 보험 가격 책정 투명 모델의 구조적 안정성 정량화
items.summary_ko: 일반 보험 계약의 짧은 기간으로 인해 데이터 분포가 빠르게 변화하며, 이는 모델 업데이트를 필요로 합니다. 이 연구는 모델 업데이트 후 예측 및 구조가 크게 달라질 수 있는 문제에 주목하여, 투명 모델의 구조적 안정성을 정량화하는 방법을 제시합니다.
items.why_ko: 금융 및 보험 분야에서 AI 모델의 신뢰성과 투명성을 높이는 데 기여하며, 규제 준수 및 모델 관리의 효율성을 개선할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Towards a Theory of Learnability via Debate
items.body: Debate has been recently proposed as a training protocol that is hoped to produce more aligned models even as model capabilities scale. The idea is that the human, instead of providing supervision in the form of labels, judges a debate between two models that compete to prove the correctness of opposite labels. It can be shown that functions of a much higher computational complexity can be correctly judged in this way, compared to the complexity of functions that can be directly evaluated using a computationally weak evaluator. This suggests that perhaps debate can be used to teach very complicated functions to models. However, previous work has largely ignored the fact that this is a training protocol, and simply analyzes the game being played between the two debaters for a known judge. We take the first steps towards understanding the learning problem implicit within the protocol, by formulating it as an online learning problem. We show that once we formulate the learning problem precisely, there are cases where the best way to learn given access to a judge is different from running an adversarial debate. This motivates us to define a cooperative version of the protocol, whose learnability we characterize using a combinatorial dimension. We also consider the possibility of the human judge being fallible and occasionally judging the debate incorrectly. We show that a small number of errors in judgement can lead to a large error in learning.
items.title_ko: 논쟁을 통한 학습 가능성 이론 구축
items.summary_ko: 논쟁(Debate)을 통해 AI 모델의 정렬(alignment)을 개선할 수 있다는 훈련 프로토콜에 대한 연구로, 인간이 직접 레이블을 제공하는 대신, 두 모델이 반대되는 주장을 입증하기 위해 경쟁하는 논쟁을 심판하는 방식입니다. 이를 통해 직접 평가하기 어려운 고도로 복잡한 함수도 정확하게 판단할 수 있음을 보여줍니다.
items.why_ko: AI 모델의 안전성과 신뢰성을 높이는 새로운 훈련 패러다임을 제시하며, 특히 인간이 이해하기 어려운 복잡한 AI 시스템의 행동을 제어하고 검증하는 데 중요한 통찰을 제공합니다.

items.title: FLEX-LBP: Learning Local Binary Patterns with Exact Binary Inference for Texture Classification
items.body: Local Binary Patterns (LBP) remain among the most widely used texture descriptors, from industrial inspection to medical imaging. Yet their radius, sampling angles, color transform and thresholds are fixed by hand for each dataset. We present FLEX-LBP, which learns these parameters by backpropagation while every forward pass computes exact binary codes and hard histogram counts. A straight-through estimator acts only in the backward pass, so the deployed descriptor is an interpretable hard-binary LBP with 90 learnable parameters and unchanged inference cost. In a controlled ablation on six color texture benchmarks, the component worth learning is dataset-dependent. One configuration, applied unchanged everywhere, learns the geometry and thresholds with the color transform frozen. It improves the nearest-neighbor accuracy of the identical fixed descriptor by 3.55 points on average over five seeds, significantly on five of six benchmarks and never significantly worse. With a linear discriminant readout, it gains 0.9 points; the fully learned descriptor gains 2.7 and has the highest mean. FLEX-LBP is more accurate than five classical LBP-family descriptors, PCANet and a neural LBP on five of six benchmarks. Its mean nearest-neighbor accuracy exceeds that of frozen ImageNet ResNet-50 features (23.5 million parameters). On the Kather colorectal cancer histology benchmark, the fully learned descriptor reaches 93.8%, significantly above the best classical descriptor (Completed LBP, 92.8%). The learned radii adapt in directions that recur across seeds. Noise drowns single-pixel comparisons and illuminant change flips inter-channel ones; median sampling or gray-world normalization restores 96-97%. The code is available as a drop-in PyTorch layer at https://github.com/medalimoussa/FLEX-LBP.
items.title_ko: FLEX-LBP: 정확한 이진 추론을 통한 텍스처 분류용 지역 이진 패턴 학습
items.summary_ko: FLEX-LBP는 백프로파게이션을 통해 지역 이진 패턴(LBP)의 파라미터를 학습하면서도, 정확한 이진 코드와 하드 히스토그램 카운트를 계산하는 새로운 텍스처 디스크립터입니다. 이는 산업 검사부터 의료 영상까지 광범위하게 사용되는 LBP의 고정된 파라미터 문제를 해결합니다.
items.why_ko: 텍스처 분류 알고리즘의 유연성과 성능을 향상시켜, 컴퓨터 비전 분야의 다양한 실제 애플리케이션에 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Consistent Video-to-Video Translation via Explicit Correspondences
items.body: Interactive video-to-video applications require real-time generation while maintaining long-range temporal consistency. However, recent methods achieve speed by restricting attention to a fixed-length causal window. This limits long-range consistency whenever relevant history falls outside the context window. To address this limitation, we introduce vid2vid-long, a correspondence-based approach grounded in a simple observation. Video-to-video translation provides an explicit cross-frame reference: the regions that match in the input video should match in the output video too. Concretely, we compute patch-level correspondences in the input, guiding retrieval of previously generated outputs in the corresponding regions, and condition the model on these patches through correspondence cross-attention. Our experiments demonstrate that vid2vid-long consistently improves long-range temporal consistency across recent video models while preserving generation quality and real-time performance.
items.title_ko: 명시적 대응을 통한 일관된 비디오-투-비디오 번역
items.summary_ko: 비디오-투-비디오 번역에서 장거리 시간적 일관성을 유지하면서 실시간 생성을 달성하는 방법인 vid2vid-long을 소개합니다. 기존 방법론이 고정 길이의 인과적 창에만 주의를 제한하여 장거리 일관성을 유지하기 어려운 점을 해결하기 위해 대응(correspondence) 기반 접근 방식을 사용합니다.
items.why_ko: 실시간 비디오 생성 및 편집 애플리케이션에서 장거리 시간적 일관성 문제를 해결하여, 고품질 비디오 콘텐츠 생성 및 인터랙티브 미디어 경험을 향상시킬 수 있습니다.

items.title: Goal Encoding in LLMs
items.body: We investigate whether and how LLMs encode goals: internal neural representations that precede and guide action, and that are flexible enough to be realized through many different execution paths. We construct a coding setting with multiple sub-tasks that allows us to evaluate goal-seeking behavior and the selection of sub-goals. In this setting, we localize an encoding of the next sub-goal in the outputs of a sparse set of attention heads. The same heads can be used to decode the LM's future actions in natural language (e.g., "I'm checking if a word is a palindrome"). We verify that this encoding is causal for next action and is plastic: transplanting it into a different environment, e.g., another programming language, triggers the same operation realized with a different sequence of tokens. The LM also sustains the encoding throughout the action's execution, which is puzzling because a transformer LM without recurrence cannot carry a state forward for more tokens than it has layers left. We propose that it does not need to. Under a non-recurrent goal-seeking (NRGS) account, the LM frequently re-reads the goal from the task specification, compares it with the progress visible in the growing context, and pursues what remains. We test the predictions of this account with targeted causal interventions.
items.title_ko: LLM에서의 목표 인코딩
items.summary_ko: LLM이 목표를 어떻게 인코딩하는지, 즉 행동에 앞서 내부적으로 목표를 어떻게 표현하고 안내하는지 조사합니다. 다중 하위 작업을 포함하는 코딩 설정을 구성하여 목표 추구 행동과 하위 목표 선택을 평가하며, 특정 어텐션 헤드의 출력에서 다음 하위 목표의 인코딩을 국지화할 수 있음을 발견했습니다.
items.why_ko: LLM의 내부 작동 방식을 이해하고, 복잡한 다단계 작업을 수행하는 에이전트의 목표 지향적 행동을 제어하고 개선하는 데 중요한 기반 지식을 제공합니다.

items.title: Metal Sandbox: Isolated Execution and Command Scheduling for GPU Coding Agents on Apple Silicon
items.body: On-device inference requires kernels that make effective use of local accelerators. Efficient training and evaluation of models that generate Apple Metal kernels benefit from native macOS tools and concurrent agent sessions. These sessions alternate between model requests, development commands, and GPU execution, leaving GPU capacity idle for much of a rollout. We present Metal Sandbox, infrastructure that combines restricted per-instance file access, native command execution, and command-level scheduling across interconnected Macs. Each agent retains its workspace and private development environment. Parallel commands can run concurrently, while serial commands share one execution slot per node; eligible waiting commands can migrate to available Macs and return results to the original agent. Integration with Harbor supports task execution, automatic verification, and rollout collection through a common workflow. Controlled experiments on four Mac mini M4 nodes achieve $1.68\times$--$2.05\times$ gains in command throughput under concentrated demand. Sixteen static agent traces give an estimated $2.14\times$ sustained-throughput gain for four sessions per node versus one, assuming continuously replenished sessions and unchanged mean durations. Replaying these measured traces under dynamic scheduling reduces mean tool waiting by 18.8% and batch elapsed time by 22.3%, assuming unchanged phase durations. Metal Sandbox and its Harbor integration are open-source on GitHub.
items.title_ko: Metal Sandbox: Apple Silicon GPU 코딩 에이전트를 위한 격리된 실행 및 명령 스케줄링
items.summary_ko: Metal Sandbox는 Apple Silicon GPU 코딩 에이전트를 위한 격리된 실행 및 명령 수준 스케줄링 인프라를 제공합니다. 이는 온디바이스 추론에 필요한 효율적인 Metal 커널 생성 모델의 훈련 및 평가에 도움이 됩니다.
items.why_ko: Apple Silicon 환경에서 GPU 기반 AI 모델 개발 및 최적화를 가속화하여, 엣지 디바이스에서의 고성능 AI 애플리케이션 개발에 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Negative-Only Policy Optimization for One-Sided Verifiable Rewards
items.body: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) typically relies on a verifier that can reliably judge whether sampled solutions are correct. However, in many realistic settings, complete verification is generally unavailable, while cheap checks can only falsify failures. We formalize this regime as one-sided verifiability (OSV): verified negatives are reliable counterexamples, but verified positives are merely non-falsified candidates and may contain many false positives. This asymmetry makes standard RLVR unreliable, because reinforcing verified positives can directly reward shortcuts that pass partial checks. To address this issue, we propose Negative-Only Policy Optimization (NOPO), which treats verified positives as unlabeled and updates the policy only by suppressing trusted verified negatives. Specifically, NOPO combines a reference-relative negative suppression loss with a group-level adapter that scales each update by the proportion of non-falsified responses. Across unit-test, constraint-check, and LLM self-verifiers, NOPO improves pass@k over baselines on code, logic, and math benchmarks when oracle rewards are unavailable. These gains persist under inference-time scaling and cross-benchmark transfer.
items.title_ko: 편측 검증 가능한 보상을 위한 음성 전용 정책 최적화
items.summary_ko: 강화 학습에서 편측 검증 가능성(OSV)이라는 현실적인 환경을 형식화하고, 이를 위한 음성 전용 정책 최적화(Negative-Only Policy Optimization) 방법을 제안합니다. OSV에서는 실패는 확실히 검증 가능하지만, 성공은 단순히 '실패하지 않음'일 뿐이며, 많은 거짓 양성을 포함할 수 있습니다.
items.why_ko: 실제 세계의 불완전한 피드백 환경에서 강화 학습 에이전트의 학습 효율성과 신뢰성을 높이는 새로운 접근 방식을 제시하여, 보다 견고한 AI 시스템 개발에 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Synthesis Smuggling: Maliciously Hiding Inferred Personal Attributes in LLM Outputs
items.body: We propose Synthesis Smuggling, a novel threat model in which an adversarial LLM infers sensitive information about a user from routine assistance-seeking interactions and steganographically encodes that into innocuous-looking model-generated content. The user may then unknowingly transmit that information by sharing the generated artifact, say as an email, social-media post, or message, through ordinary communication channels. An adversary monitoring these channels can discover this information. We demonstrate this threat by training two open-weight models to infer gender and age-group labels from conversational cues and encode their predictions using invisible characters or word choices. These results show that user-shared model outputs can become a covert channel for personal inferences, even when the model itself has no direct means of contacting an adversary.
items.body_ko: 우리는 Synthesis Smuggling을 제안합니다. 이는 적대적인 LLM이 일상적인 지원 요청 상호작용에서 사용자에 대한 민감한 정보를 추론하고, 무해해 보이는 모델 생성 콘텐츠에 은밀하게 인코딩하는 새로운 위협 모델입니다. 사용자는 이메일, 소셜 미디어 게시물 또는 메시지와 같이 일반적인 통신 채널을 통해 생성된 아티팩트를 공유함으로써 해당 정보를 알지 못하는 사이에 전송할 수 있습니다. 이러한 채널을 모니터링하는 공격자는 이 정보를 발견할 수 있습니다. 우리는 두 개의 공개 가중치 모델을 학습시켜 대화 단서로부터 성별 및 연령 그룹 레이블을 추론하고 보이지 않는 문자 또는 단어 선택을 사용하여 예측을 인코딩함으로써 이 위협을 시연합니다. 이러한 결과는 모델 자체가 공격자와 직접 접촉할 수단이 없더라도 사용자 공유 모델 출력이 개인 추론을 위한 은밀한 채널이 될 수 있음을 보여줍니다.
items.title_ko: 합성 밀수: LLM 출력에 추론된 개인 속성 악의적으로 숨기기
items.summary_ko: Synthesis Smuggling은 악의적인 LLM이 사용자 상호작용을 통해 민감한 정보를 추론하고, 이를 무해해 보이는 모델 생성 콘텐츠에 스테가노그래피 방식으로 숨기는 새로운 위협 모델을 제안합니다. 사용자가 이 정보를 무의식적으로 공유하면 모니터링하는 공격자가 정보를 탈취할 수 있습니다.
items.why_ko: LLM의 개인 정보 보호 및 보안에 대한 심각한 위협을 보여주며, LLM 개발자들이 프라이버시 침해 및 정보 유출 가능성에 대비하여 보다 강력한 보안 메커니즘을 설계해야 할 필요성을 강조합니다.

items.title: LiveGeo: Benchmarking Geographic Agents in Continuously Evolving Worlds
items.body: We introduce GeoWorld, a controllable and continuously evolving geographic environment platform for LLM agents, and LiveGeo, a benchmark for evaluating reliable decision-making in real-world geographic environments using GeoWorld. Unlike existing evaluations that largely reason and plan over fixed geographic states, GeoWorld is grounded in real-world geographic structure and allows external world states to evolve along their own temporal processes while preserving verifiable state histories. LiveGeo places geographic tasks within this evolving environment, requiring agents to actively acquire task-relevant information, verify whether the evidence supporting prior decisions remains valid, and revise their plans when necessary. Our results reveal that even frontier LLMs struggle with static tasks, with no model consistently excelling across tasks, while strong static performance does not ensure dynamic reliability. Further analysis identifies a key bottleneck: agents struggle to acquire and translate relevant evidence into valid decisions and maintain their correctness as the world evolves. By releasing LiveGeo together with its GeoWorld platform, we aim to provide the community with a flexible and extensible infrastructure for studying the next generation of agents capable of reliable action in evolving geographic worlds.
items.title_ko: LiveGeo: 지속적으로 진화하는 환경에서 지리 에이전트 벤치마킹
items.summary_ko: LLM 에이전트의 지리적 의사결정을 평가하기 위한 GeoWorld 플랫폼과 LiveGeo 벤치마크를 소개합니다. GeoWorld는 실제 지리적 구조를 기반으로 하며, 외부 환경 상태가 자체적인 시간적 프로세스에 따라 진화하면서도 검증 가능한 상태 이력을 유지합니다.
items.why_ko: 실시간으로 변화하는 복잡한 지리적 환경에서 AI 에이전트의 신뢰성 있는 의사결정 능력을 평가하고 개선하는 데 중요한 도구로, 자율 주행, 물류, 재난 대응 등 다양한 분야에 응용될 수 있습니다.

items.title: Programming Quantum Circuit Parameters with Large Language Models
items.body: Large language models (LLMs) have recently demonstrated the ability to generate parameters for variational quantum circuits without conventional optimization. However, the conditions under which this approach is effective remain unclear. Here, we investigate a frozen, general-purpose LLM that generates complete circuit parameter vectors from symbolic circuit and Hamiltonian descriptions, with optional iterative energy feedback. We evaluate the approach on general random Hamiltonians, structured parent Hamiltonians, and molecular systems. For general Hamiltonians, LLM-generated parameters exhibit larger energy errors than conventional Adam optimization, while additional feedback generally provides limited improvement. In contrast, for structured Hamiltonians, the LLM can generate promising low-energy parameter configurations, suggesting that identifiable physical and mathematical structure facilitates parameter inference. We also show that direct LLM predictions of minimum energies can violate the Hamiltonian spectral lower bound, whereas generated circuit parameters allow independent evaluation of physically realizable energy expectation values. Finally, we investigate blind circuit interpretation and find that the LLM can predict measurement outcomes even when it fails to identify the underlying quantum algorithm. These findings highlight the role of problem structure, the limitations of iterative LLM optimization, and the importance of independently verifiable predictions in quantum parameter programming.
items.title_ko: 대규모 언어 모델로 양자 회로 파라미터 프로그래밍
items.summary_ko: LLM이 최적화 과정 없이 변분 양자 회로(variational quantum circuits)의 파라미터를 생성하는 능력을 조사합니다. 이 연구는 고정된 범용 LLM이 기호적 회로 및 해밀턴 설명으로부터 완전한 회로 파라미터 벡터를 생성하고, 선택적으로 반복적인 에너지 피드백을 활용하는 방법을 평가합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM이 복잡한 과학 및 공학 분야, 특히 양자 컴퓨팅에서 새로운 문제 해결 도구로 활용될 가능성을 보여주며, 양자 회로 설계의 효율성을 높일 수 있습니다.

items.title: Ballad: Bandit-Based LLM Routing for Automated Heuristic Discovery
items.body: Modern automated heuristic discovery (AHD) systems increasingly rival hand-crafted heuristics by leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) to iteratively mutate and refine solutions. A natural assumption is that more powerful and more expensive models consistently yield better heuristics. We challenge this empirically: across multiple NP-hard combinatorial optimization problems, we find no consistent advantage for larger, costlier models. This raises a deeper question: given a pool of LLMs spanning frontier and freely hosted or open-weight models, how should one adaptively select which model to invoke at each step of the search? The challenge is non-trivial. The optimal LLM may shift over the course of a run, and because one LLM's output seeds the context for subsequent calls, each model's reward signal is non-stationary and entangled across the heuristic population, thus violating the independence assumptions of classical online decision-making settings. We address this through Ballad (Bandit-based LLM Routing for Automated Heuristic Discovery), an online bandit algorithm that learns to orchestrate a pool of LLMs into an ensemble that matches or exceeds what any soloist LLM achieves alone. This orchestration is powered by an LLM selection policy that favors rare, high-scoring heuristics over stable averages, a DAG-based credit propagation mechanism through the genealogy of the heuristic population, and discounting of stale observations to remain attuned to each model's current utility. Across five NP-hard combinatorial optimization problems and a pool of four models of varying capability and cost, Ballad not only matches the best individual LLM in hindsight but, in several cases, surpasses every individual model while reducing API cost by up to 65.6% relative to always using the strongest model.
items.title_ko: Ballad: 자동화된 발견을 위한 밴딧 기반 LLM 라우팅
items.summary_ko: Ballad는 LLM을 활용한 자동화된 휴리스틱 발견(AHD) 시스템에서 여러 LLM 중 어떤 모델을 사용할지 동적으로 선택하는 밴딧(Bandit) 기반 라우팅 시스템입니다. 더 강력하고 비싼 모델이 항상 더 나은 휴리스틱을 제공하는 것은 아니라는 실증적 발견에 기반합니다.
items.why_ko: 다양한 LLM의 성능과 비용을 고려하여 최적의 모델을 선택하는 효율적인 전략을 제시하며, 이는 LLM 기반 시스템의 비용 효율성을 높이고 성능을 최적화하는 데 실질적인 도움을 줄 수 있습니다.

items.title: When Both Sides Adapt: The Challenges of Evaluating Interactive LLM Systems
items.body: In interactive systems where users engage with LLMs, users are adaptive and, after observing LLM responses, can change their prompting strategy, as well as the type and difficulty of subsequent tasks. Thus model responses can influence the set of prompts on which the model is subsequently evaluated. We study the implications of this user adaptivity and prompt endogeneity for the evaluation of LLMs. We define two classes of estimands for comparing models: the common-distribution effect, which compares model performance on the same distribution of prompts, and the induced-distribution effect, which compares each model on the prompt distribution generated through user interaction. We show that offline benchmark evaluation and live A/B testing target different quantities, with the standard difference-in-means estimators for the two methods converging to the common-distribution effect and the induced-distribution effect, respectively. This distinction can affect decision-making: the two comparisons can rank models differently and lead to discrepancies in deployment recommendations. We characterize when such ranking reversals occur and provide a sufficient condition under which the rankings are guaranteed to agree. This result provides a practical heuristic for assessing whether offline evaluation is sufficient to reproduce the decision suggested by a live experiment. Third, we show, in a stylized linear model of interactions, that user adaptivity can increase variance in estimation. Finally, we discuss implications of user adaptivity for the interpretation of experiments and show that adaptivity creates a common mechanism leading to common evaluation challenges, such as reward hacking and novelty effects. Together, this work highlights the necessity of measuring both model performance as well as changes in the user behavior that the model induces.
items.title_ko: 양측이 적응할 때: 대화형 LLM 시스템 평가의 도전 과제
items.summary_ko: 사용자와 LLM이 상호작용하는 시스템에서 사용자가 LLM 응답에 따라 프롬프트 전략을 변경하고, 후속 작업의 유형과 난이도를 조절하는 적응성을 연구합니다. 이러한 사용자 적응성과 프롬프트 내생성(prompt endogeneity)이 LLM 평가에 미치는 영향을 분석합니다.
items.why_ko: 대화형 AI 시스템의 실제 성능을 정확하게 평가하기 위한 새로운 프레임워크와 고려사항을 제시하여, 더욱 현실적이고 신뢰할 수 있는 LLM 평가 방법을 개발하는 데 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Al-Ghasali: A Computational Framework for Simulating Islamic Jurisprudential Rulings via Finite State Automata and Large Language Models
items.body: This paper presents Al Ghasali, a computational framework designed to formalize and simulate Islamic jurisprudential (Fiqh) rulings. Building upon recent set theoretic formalizations of al sabr wa al Taqsim that extract minimal operational rules as simple Horn clause logical programs, this work proves that the semantics of closed Fiqh chapters collapse completely to deterministic Finite State Automata (FSA). We establish a formal computational hierarchy, demonstrating that restricting formalization to finite propositional Horn theories guarantees decidability and constant time (O(1)) verdict extraction after offline compilation. The framework formally proves that hierarchical compositions of sub-chapter FSAs preserve this O(1) complexity, and that temporal juristic requirements, such as Tartib (order), are deterministically flattened into static ontological states, preserving the memoryless property of the automaton. To generate human-readable juristic summaries, Al Ghasali incorporates Large Language Models (LLMs) via an architecture where the deterministic FSA strictly controls the probabilistic LLM. Crucially, the paper formulates sufficient design safety conditions for this FSA LLM integration, ensuring strict adherence to the epistemological boundaries of Usul al Fiqh. To neutralize the risk of LLM hallucination, the system employs a Grammar Guided Constrained Decoding mechanism. We formally define the mapping function that dynamically constructs unambiguous right linear grammars from the FSA execution history. The paper mathematically proves that this architecture, augmented by a Bounded Neutral Lexicon and Valence Locking, guarantees the absolute absence of Decisional Hallucination, Juristic Factual Hallucination, and Semantic Inversion reducing the LLM to a pure linguistic transformer of deterministic juristic facts
items.title_ko: Al-Ghasali: 유한 상태 오토마타 및 LLM을 통한 이슬람 법학 판례 시뮬레이션 프레임워크
items.summary_ko: Al-Ghasali는 이슬람 법학(Fiqh) 판례를 형식화하고 시뮬레이션하기 위한 계산 프레임워크입니다. 이 연구는 폐쇄된 Fiqh 챕터의 의미론이 결정론적 유한 상태 오토마타(FSA)로 완전히 축소될 수 있음을 증명합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM과 계산 모델이 인문학 및 법학 분야의 복잡한 추론을 분석하고 시뮬레이션하는 데 활용될 수 있음을 보여주며, 학제 간 연구의 새로운 가능성을 제시합니다.

items.title: Two mathematical models of knowledge distillation
items.body: Many hypotheses compete to explain the successes of knowledge distillation. To help address this, we propose and analyze a mathematical model of distillation, which suggests that distillation's performance comes not from obtaining better models but from easier to optimize landscapes. For generalized linear models trained with stochastic gradient descent, we prove that distillation fits performant student models asymptotically more quickly than non-distilled models. In rank-1 matrix approximation, we characterize conditions on the target matrix under which gradient descent with distillation converges strictly faster than training on the supervised objective. The theory helps delineate the ways distillation provides benefits (i.e., in optimization speed, not in generalization), and experiments on real datasets corroborate the theoretical predictions.
items.title_ko: 지식 증류의 두 가지 수학적 모델
items.summary_ko: 지식 증류(Knowledge Distillation)의 성공 원인을 설명하기 위한 두 가지 수학적 모델을 제안하고 분석합니다. 이 모델은 증류의 성능이 더 나은 모델을 얻는 것이 아니라, 최적화하기 더 쉬운 학습 공간에서 비롯된다고 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: 지식 증류의 이론적 기반을 강화하고, 효율적인 모델 훈련 및 최적화 전략 개발에 대한 깊은 이해를 제공하여, AI 모델의 실용성을 높일 수 있습니다.

items.title: Linear Regression with Self-Selection Bias in Polynomial Time
items.body:
We revisit the problem of estimating $k$ linear regressors with self-selection bias in $n$ dimensions up to error $\varepsilon$ with the maximum self-selection criterion, as introduced by Cherapanamjeri, Daskalakis, Ilyas, and Zampetakis [CDIZ23, STOC]. Our main result is a $\mathrm{poly}(n,k,1/\varepsilon)$ time algorithm for the unknown-index variant of this problem, thereby improving upon the running times of the best known algorithms due to Gaitonde and Mossel [GM24] and Kalavasis, Mehrotra, and Zhou [KMZ26, COLT] with exponential dependence on $k$. Our algorithm succeeds in the presence of correlated noise between regressors, which captures the related setting of max-affine regression. Consequently, we also give the first polynomial-time algorithm for this problem, improving on the prior works of Ghosh, Pananjady, Guntuboyina, and Ramchandran [GPGR22, IEEE Transactions on Information Theory] and Gaitonde and Mossel [GM24] with exponential dependence on $k$.
Prior works exhaustively search over a $k$-dimensional subspace spanned by the regressors, using conditional moments of the response to test candidates. In contrast, our algorithm is driven by an improved understanding of the moments of the covariates. We show that, restricting to observations with large response values, the degree-$(\log n)$ Hermite moment of the covariates approximately decomposes as a sum of tensor powers of the regressors. The first step of our algorithm can be viewed as a tensor decomposition algorithm for these implicitly represented high-order tensors, which outputs unit vectors parallel to the regressors. A secondary step based on a simple variant of ordinary least squares extracts estimates for the regressors given these unit vectors. We believe our analytic insight and algorithmic components may have applications to designing efficient algorithms for other latent-variable problems.
items.title_ko: 다항 시간 내 자기 선택 편향을 가진 선형 회귀
items.summary_ko: 자기 선택 편향(self-selection bias)이 있는 선형 회귀 문제를 다항 시간 내에 해결하는 알고리즘을 제안합니다. 이 연구는 Cherapanamjeri, Daskalakis, Ilyas, and Zampetakis가 소개한 최대 자기 선택 기준을 사용하여 이 문제에 대한 기존 알고리즘의 실행 시간을 개선합니다.
items.why_ko: 데이터 편향 문제가 흔한 실제 데이터 분석 환경에서 선형 회귀 모델의 정확성과 신뢰성을 높이는 데 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Sheaf-Inspired Structured Scoring Extensions of LightGCN for Collaborative Filtering
items.body: Graph-based collaborative filtering learns user and item representations by propagating embeddings over a user--item interaction graph. We investigate a modular, sheaf-inspired scoring extension placed on top of a three-layer LightGCN backbone. The motivation comes from cellular sheaves, where local vector spaces are related by linear restriction maps; here, this idea motivates structured, pair-dependent transformations of user and item embeddings rather than a change to graph propagation. We compare the identity inner-product scorer, diagonal, rank-one low-rank, and full matrix residual scorers, and a parameter-matched residual MLP baseline (\texttt{mlp\_full}) on Amazon-Book, Gowalla, MovieLens-1M, and Yelp2018. We report ranking quality and catalog coverage at cutoffs 10 and 20. The selected structured variants show modest, dataset-dependent changes in ranking quality and sometimes substantial changes in coverage. Our method is inspired by sheaf geometry but does not construct a cellular sheaf or implement sheaf-Laplacian diffusion; the experiments therefore do not establish a causal benefit from sheaf geometry itself.
items.title_ko: 협업 필터링을 위한 LightGCN의 셰프-영감 구조화된 스코어링 확장
items.summary_ko: 그래프 기반 협업 필터링 모델인 LightGCN에 셰프(sheaf)-영감 구조화된 스코어링 확장 기능을 도입합니다. 이 접근 방식은 사용자 및 아이템 임베딩에 대한 구조화된, 쌍 의존적 변환을 통해 그래프 전파 방식 대신 협업 필터링 성능을 개선합니다.
items.why_ko: 추천 시스템의 핵심 기술인 협업 필터링의 정확성을 높여, 사용자에게 더욱 관련성 높은 추천을 제공하고 서비스 품질을 향상시킬 수 있습니다.

items.title: Data Archive for 2D and 3D Electrical Impedance Tomography with moderate conductivity contrast phantoms
items.body: This document describes open Electrical Impedance Tomography (EIT) measurement data that were collected from biomedical imaging inspired phantoms with moderate conductivity contrasts. The data were collected with the KIT4 and KIT5 EIT measurement devices at the University of Eastern Finland, and are intended for EIT image reconstruction algorithm development and testing. The data from thoracic imaging inspired cylindrical and chest-shaped phantoms are suitable for 2D algorithms, and the data from an intracerebral hemorrhage imaging inspired head-shaped phantom with resistive skull are suitable for 3D algorithms. In addition to the measurement data, computational meshes and example reconstruction codes are provided and sample reconstructions included.
items.title_ko: 중간 전도도 대비 팬텀을 이용한 2D 및 3D 전기 임피던스 단층 촬영 데이터 아카이브
items.summary_ko: 생체 의료 영상에서 영감을 받은 중간 전도도 대비 팬텀으로 수집된 2D 및 3D 전기 임피던스 단층 촬영(EIT) 측정 데이터 아카이브를 제공합니다. 이 데이터는 EIT 이미지 재구성 알고리즘 개발 및 테스트에 활용될 수 있습니다.
items.why_ko: 의료 영상 분야의 AI 알고리즘 개발을 위한 공개 데이터를 제공하여, 진단 기술 발전 및 연구 활성화에 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Combinatorial Bernoulli Factories with Polynomially Many Coins
items.body: We provide an efficient implementation of combinatorial Bernoulli factories. Such a factory turns coins of unknown biases $x$ into a random vertex of a polytope $P$ whose mean is exactly $x$. For every affine slice of the cube (the class of polytopes that admit a factory), we give a single algorithm whose expected number of coin flips and running time at every interior $x$ are polynomial in the dimension and in $1/{δ_*}$, where ${δ_*}=\min_i\{x_i,1-x_i\}$ is never supplied to the algorithm. For perfect matchings this gives $O(n^{8}{δ_*}^{-2}\log(n/{δ_*}))$ flips, while the factory of Niazadeh, Paes Leme, and Schneider [STOC 2021] spends at least $n^{2n-1}$ flips in expectation at the uniform doubly stochastic matrix. For other polytopes, our method rounds exactly given a point deep inside $P$ and the promise that $x$ is far from the boundary of $P$.
items.title_ko: 다항식 코인을 가진 조합 베르누이 팩토리
items.summary_ko: 조합 베르누이 팩토리(combinatorial Bernoulli factories)의 효율적인 구현을 제공합니다. 이 팩토리는 알 수 없는 편향 $x$를 가진 코인을 사용하여 평균이 정확히 $x$인 다면체 $P$의 무작위 정점을 생성합니다.
items.why_ko: 확률적 샘플링 및 무작위성 생성 분야의 이론적, 실용적 발전에 기여하며, 통계 모델링 및 시뮬레이션에 응용될 수 있습니다.

items.title: Scalable Conversational Assessment: Chat-Based Exams with a Two-Agent LLM Pipeline
items.body: Oral exams are compelling because (1) students can be asked to provide their reasoning for an answer and (2) their interactive nature permits follow-up questions to resolve ambiguous answers. But oral exams scale poorly. In this paper, we present scalable conversational assessment, an LLM-based system that conducts interactive text-based conversations with students to assess their ability to make and support an argument. We use a two-agent architecture to separate concerns and reduce the likelihood that answers are leaked to the student: the interviewer interacts directly with the student, but only receives guidance about the next question to ask the student; the hidden evaluator knows the goals of the whole activity, tracks the student's progress using a rubric, and guides the interviewer on when to follow-up on the current question or proceed to the next question. The system was first tested using a collection of simulated students with LLM personas of a particular ability level or adversarial tactic (e.g., answer-extractors, prompt-injectors, confident fabricators). A novel element of this evaluation was that it required the use of a fictional assessment topic to prevent personas that shouldn't have information from using knowledge present in the LLM's pre-training. The system was also deployed in a small, elective AI literacy course in both formative and summative contexts. Through manual and post-facto AI review of the transcripts we identified opportunities to improve the follow-up question generation and ensure that grading only credited ideas that the student (and not the interviewer) contributed.
items.body_ko: 구술 시험은 (1) 학생들에게 답변에 대한 추론을 요구할 수 있고, (2) 상호 작용적 특성으로 인해 모호한 답변을 해결하기 위한 추가 질문이 가능하기 때문에 매력적입니다. 그러나 구술 시험은 확장성이 좋지 않습니다. 이 논문에서 우리는 학생들이 주장을 만들고 뒷받침하는 능력을 평가하기 위해 학생들과 상호 작용적인 텍스트 기반 대화를 진행하는 LLM 기반 시스템인 확장 가능한 대화형 평가를 제시합니다. 우리는 우려 사항을 분리하고 답변이 학생에게 유출될 가능성을 줄이기 위해 두 에이전트 아키텍처를 사용합니다. 인터뷰어는 학생과 직접 상호 작용하지만 학생에게 물을 다음 질문에 대한 지침만 받습니다. 숨겨진 평가자는 전체 활동의 목표를 알고, 루브릭을 사용하여 학생의 진행 상황을 추적하며, 인터뷰어에게 현재 질문에 대해 추가 질문을 할 시기 또는 다음 질문으로 넘어갈 시기에 대해 지시합니다. 이 시스템은 특정 능력 수준 또는 적대적 전술(예: 답변 추출기, 프롬프트 주입기, 자신감 있는 조작자)을 가진 LLM 페르소나를 사용하는 시뮬레이션된 학생 컬렉션을 사용하여 처음 테스트되었습니다. 이 평가의 새로운 요소는 정보를 가져서는 안 되는 페르소나가 LLM의 사전 학습에 존재하는 지식을 사용하는 것을 방지하기 위해 가상의 평가 주제를 사용해야 한다는 것이었습니다. 이 시스템은 또한 작고 선택적인 AI 리터러시 과정에서 형성적 및 총괄적 맥락 모두에서 배포되었습니다. 스크립트의 수동 및 사후 AI 검토를 통해 추가 질문 생성에 대한 개선 기회를 식별하고 채점이 학생(인터뷰어가 아닌)이 기여한 아이디어에만 가산되도록 보장했습니다.
items.title_ko: 확장 가능한 대화형 평가: 두 에이전트 LLM 파이프라인을 활용한 채팅 기반 시험
items.summary_ko: 구두 시험의 장점(추론 과정 확인, 모호한 답변에 대한 후속 질문)을 살리면서 확장성 문제를 해결하기 위해 LLM 기반의 대화형 평가 시스템을 제안합니다. 두 에이전트 아키텍처를 사용하여 학생들과 상호작용하며 논증 능력과 근거 제시 능력을 평가합니다.
items.why_ko: AI를 활용한 교육 및 평가 시스템의 혁신적인 발전 가능성을 보여주며, 대규모 교육 환경에서 학생들의 심층적인 이해도를 평가하는 효율적인 방법을 제공할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Introducing Feedback Delays to Non-Delayed Adversarial MDPs: Optimal $\sqrt S$ and $\sqrt K$ Dependencies in Tabular and Linear AMDPs
items.body:
We study regret minimization in episodic Adversarial Markov Decision Processes (AMDPs) with unknown transitions and bandit feedback. In tabular AMDPs with $S$ states, $A$ actions, and horizon $H$, the best known $K$-episode regret is $\tilde O(HS\sqrt{AK})$, whose $\sqrt S$ gap to the $Ω(H\sqrt{SAK})$ lower bound has long remained open. In linear AMDPs with $d$-dimensional features, after a five-year line of improvements starting from $K^{14/15}$, computationally efficient algorithms without a simulator or exploratory assumptions still only attain $\tilde O(K^{3/4})$ regret.
A common challenge in both settings is to estimate the Q-function of a changing policy: past data comes from earlier policies that differ from (and are correlated with) the current one, while freezing the policy for future episodes worsens the dependency on $K$. We instead propose a general technique called introduced feedback delays: we estimate the Q-function of the policy using future episodes while still updating the policy, as if the feedback were delayed. While feedback delays are usually an obstacle imposed by the environment, here they are introduced voluntarily and, perhaps surprisingly, come at no extra cost. We develop Geometric Resampling with Rejection (GRR) to account for policy changes during the delay, and threshold the visitation probabilities to avoid long delays on rarely visited state-action pairs.
With this unified technique, our policy optimization algorithms achieve, with high probability, $\tilde O(\text{poly}(H)\sqrt{SAK})$ regret in tabular AMDPs, resolving the open problem; and $\tilde O(\text{poly}(d,H)\sqrt K)$ regret in linear AMDPs, giving the first efficient algorithm optimal in $K$. They also naturally extend to delayed AMDPs with a total feedback delay $\mathfrak D$, yielding the first bounds optimal in $S$ and $\mathfrak D$ (tabular) and in $K$ and $\mathfrak D$ (linear).
items.title_ko: 비지연 적대적 MDP에 피드백 지연 도입: Tabular 및 Linear AMDP에서 최적의 $\sqrt S$ 및 $\sqrt K$ 의존성
items.summary_ko: 미지의 전이(unknown transitions)와 밴딧 피드백(bandit feedback)이 있는 에피소드 적대적 마르코프 의사결정 과정(AMDP)에서 후회 최소화 문제를 연구합니다. 이 연구는 기존의 $K^{14/15}$에서 벗어나 Tabular 및 Linear AMDP에서 최적의 $\sqrt S$ 및 $\sqrt K$ 의존성을 가지는 알고리즘을 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: 강화 학습, 특히 적대적 환경에서의 의사결정 문제에서 학습 효율성을 개선하는 이론적 진전을 제공하여, 실제 환경에 적용 가능한 강력한 RL 알고리즘 개발에 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Theoretical and Empirical Analysis of Sparse Convolution
items.body: Deep neural networks for image processing are increasingly deployed on resource-constrained edge devices such as drones, medical systems, and smartphones, where limited computational resources and memory bandwidth pose significant challenges for efficient inference. Pruning during training often produces highly sparse convolutional kernels, offering the potential to significantly reduce computation and memory requirements. However, exploiting this sparsity efficiently at runtime remains challenging due to irregular memory access patterns and workload imbalance across processing elements. In this work, we investigate the standard convolution with sparse weights and analyze its performance characteristics through roofline analysis, showing that a 3 x 3 sparse convolution achieves an arithmetic intensity of approximately 10 FLOP/byte compared to roughly 96 FLOP/byte for its dense counterpart. We propose techniques for an efficient sparse convolution at high sparsities. Preliminary results demonstrate that our approach achieves upto 1.65x speedup as compared to dense convolution on NVIDIA A100 and upto 1.52x on NVIDIA Jetson Nano (Tegra X1) , motivating further exploration of direct convolution as a practical path to efficient sparse inference on modern accelerators/edge devices.
items.title_ko: 스파스 컨볼루션의 이론적 및 실증적 분석
items.summary_ko: 이미지 처리 딥러닝 모델을 드론, 의료 시스템, 스마트폰과 같은 자원 제한적인 엣지 디바이스에 배포할 때 발생하는 문제를 해결하기 위해 스파스 컨볼루션(Sparse Convolution)을 분석합니다. 훈련 중 가지치기(pruning)를 통해 얻은 희소한 컨볼루션 커널이 계산 및 메모리 요구 사항을 크게 줄일 수 있음을 보여줍니다.
items.why_ko: 엣지 디바이스에서 AI 모델을 효율적으로 실행하기 위한 핵심 기술로, 모바일 및 임베디드 AI 애플리케이션 개발에 필수적인 성능 최적화 방법을 제공합니다.

items.title: MALNISI-Infused Graph Construction and Weighted Contrastive Loss based GAT for Unsupervised Representation Learning in HSI
items.body: Hyperspectral images (HSI) possess discriminating spectral characteristics with respect to land utilization due to high-dimensional information. Recently, unsupervised representation learning using graph neural networks has unveiled these utilization-specific complex spectral relations. This article has three main contributions. First, it proposes an index, the Mean Absolute Local Neighborhood Inverse Spectral Index (MALNISI), which measures the similarity between two pixels based on their neighborhood information. The index is used to construct a weighted adjacency matrix, giving the HSI a graph structure. Second, it proposes an upgraded Graph Attention Network that learns compact latent representations of hyperspectral data from the constructed graph. In this network, an enhanced multi-head attention mechanism incorporates the MALNISI weights as an auxiliary feature to emphasize learned attention between neighboring pixels. To alleviate over-smoothing and preserve fine-grained spectral details, the architecture integrates residual connections, skip projections, and feature normalization, which together enhance representation capability, stabilize learning, and accelerate convergence. Third, it proposes a weighted contrastive loss function that incorporates neighborhood-aware MALNISI between connected pixels, encouraging strongly connected pixels in the high-dimensional space to remain close in the latent space, and weakly connected pixels to stay apart. The resulting discriminative low-dimensional embeddings are then clustered using spectral clustering. Experimental analysis on six benchmark HSI datasets demonstrates the efficiency and necessity of the three aforementioned contributions, and the comparative study highlights superior performance over fourteen state-of-the-art approaches.
items.title_ko: MALNISI 주입 그래프 구성 및 가중 컨트라스트 손실 기반 HSI 비지도 표현 학습 GAT
items.summary_ko: 초분광 영상(HSI)의 비지도 표현 학습을 위한 새로운 접근 방식을 제안합니다. 이 연구는 인접 픽셀 간의 유사성을 측정하는 MALNISI(Mean Absolute Local Neighborhood Inverse Spectral Index)를 도입하고, 이를 그래프 구성에 활용하며, 가중 컨트라스트 손실 기반 GAT(Graph Attention Network)를 사용합니다.
items.why_ko: 고차원 데이터인 초분광 영상에서 효과적인 표현 학습 방법을 제시하여, 원격 탐사, 농업, 환경 모니터링 등 다양한 분야의 AI 애플리케이션에 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Physically Interpretable Basin Selection in Discrete-Variable Origami Design
items.body: Automatic differentiation has enabled rapid progress on continuous-variable mechanical design problems, but gradient-based optimization still struggles with discrete variables. The standard approach is to optimize using a continuous relaxation of the choices, then commit to the nearest discrete design at the end. Why this procedure selects unfavorable basins is poorly understood. Here, we introduce a practical, interpretable design problem inspired by origami, in which automatic differentiation is used to design shapes with a target functional behavior. Each origami sheet has a fixed geometry, and a bilevel optimization framework tunes which one of four discrete hinge types to place at each fold. Baseline gradient-based design settles into basins with a large discretization gap: relaxed optimization solves 97% of runs, but the final, discrete solutions succeed only half the time. We find that the gap can be relieved with a surprisingly simple modification. An initialization prior uniformly biased toward the stiff, flat hinge option boosts the final solve fraction from 49% to 69%. Applying the prior adds no additional compute and leaves the optimization process unchanged. Compared to the baseline, sheets produced with the prior have greater geometric compatibility and mechanical stiffness. Directly penalizing frustration and floppiness in the outer loss function produces an even greater improvement than the prior does, raising the solve fraction to 78% and indicating that these properties help distinguish the unfavorable basins. Our results demonstrate that loss landscapes for mechanical design can have physically meaningful basins that are not robust to discretization and cause solves to fail. Targeting these basins' physical signatures, even with just an initialization bias, helps avoid them.
items.title_ko: 이산 변수 종이접기 설계에서 물리적으로 해석 가능한 분지 선택
items.summary_ko: 자동 미분(automatic differentiation)이 연속 변수 기계 설계 문제에서 빠른 발전을 가능하게 했지만, 이산 변수에서는 여전히 어려움을 겪습니다. 이 연구는 종이접기에서 영감을 받은 실용적이고 해석 가능한 설계 문제를 통해, 연속 완화(continuous relaxation)를 사용하여 최적화할 때 왜 불리한 분지가 선택되는지 탐구합니다.
items.why_ko: 재료 과학, 로봇 공학 등 이산 변수를 다루는 엔지니어링 설계 문제에서 AI 기반 최적화의 한계를 이해하고 개선하는 데 중요한 통찰을 제공합니다.

items.title: Maximizing Capacity Utilization of LoRA Adapters for Mitigating the Learning-Forgetting Trade-off
items.body: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) often underperforms full fine-tuning, especially in heterogeneous and continual-learning settings in which substantial forgetting occurs. In general, it suffers from an undesirable learning-forgetting trade-off across diverse fine-tuning settings. We identify a potential contributor: LoRA adapters, especially high-rank ones, frequently fail to realize the available capacity afforded by the configured rank. Specifically, we find that standard LoRA updates have effective rank far below their configured rank, limiting how broadly the update energy is distributed. Therefore, we propose training mechanisms that optimize the original objective while maximizing adapter effective rank. Our main method adds a simple, stable, differentiable, and SVD-free Rényi-2 effective-rank regularizer to the language-modeling loss. We also connect capacity maximization to norm-bounded updates. In mixed-domain rank sweeps on three models evaluated with multiple random seeds, a penalty weight of $λ=0.01$ lowers mean Wiki perplexity at every tested rank of at least $16$ relative to unpenalized LoRA. Mean training perplexity improves or increases by at most $0.02$ in all but one model-rank comparison. Single-task and scheduling experiments further show that the balance between learning and retention depends on the configuration. We also observe that several LoRA variants in the literature also suffer from the identified capacity issue, and our approach provides a complementary axis of improvement to LoRA-based parameter-efficient fine-tuning. These results suggest that effective rank is not only a post-hoc diagnostic of adapter quality, but a trainable objective for improving the learning-forgetting frontier. Our code is available at https://github.com/tomohiro-sawada/lora-capacity-utilization
items.title_ko: 학습-망각 트레이드오프 완화를 위한 LoRA 어댑터의 용량 활용 극대화
items.summary_ko: LoRA(Low-Rank Adaptation)가 특히 이질적이고 연속 학습 환경에서 전체 미세 조정보다 성능이 떨어지며 상당한 망각이 발생한다는 문제를 다룹니다. 이 연구는 LoRA 어댑터, 특히 고랭크 어댑터가 구성된 랭크가 제공하는 가용 용량을 제대로 활용하지 못하는 것이 한 가지 원인임을 밝혀내고, 이 문제를 해결하기 위한 방법을 모색합니다.
items.why_ko: LoRA와 같은 파라미터 효율적인 미세 조정 기법의 성능을 개선하고, 지속적인 학습 환경에서 모델의 망각 문제를 완화하여 AI 모델의 실용성과 효율성을 높일 수 있습니다.

items.title: Cortex-FL: Agent-Mediated Collaboration for Federated Learning
items.body: Federated learning (FL) enables independent data owners to train models collaboratively without centralizing raw data. However, identifying collaborators, preparing training tasks, and coordinating execution and incentives hinder its practical adoption by organizations without specialized expertise. We present Cortex-FL, an agent-native FL system that enables users to express learning objectives in natural language and delegate the collaboration required to train a model. Agents translate these objectives into shared tasks, discover collaborators, and negotiate participation agreements, connecting collaboration formation with distributed training and incentive management. The architecture separates agent coordination from local execution authority, allowing owners to delegate coordination while retaining control over their data, computation, and financial commitments. We demonstrate the complete workflow on a four-node deployment, in which a model requested in natural language proceeds through collaboration formation, contract-governed training, verified model delivery, and x402 settlement on a blockchain testnet.
items.title_ko: Cortex-FL: 에이전트 매개 협업을 통한 연합 학습
items.summary_ko: Cortex-FL은 사용자가 자연어로 학습 목표를 표현하고, 모델 훈련에 필요한 협업을 에이전트에게 위임할 수 있는 에이전트 기반 연합 학습(Federated Learning, FL) 시스템입니다. FL의 실제 채택을 방해하는 협력자 식별, 훈련 작업 준비, 실행 및 인센티브 조율 등의 문제를 해결합니다.
items.why_ko: 연합 학습의 실제 적용을 가속화하고, 분산된 환경에서 여러 조직이 데이터 프라이버시를 유지하면서 AI 모델을 공동으로 훈련할 수 있도록 지원하는 핵심 기술입니다.

items.title: Parsed, Plausible, Wrong: Output Format Controls Silent Errors in Small-Model Semantic Parsing
items.body: A small fine-tuned parser that emits a well-formed but wrong tree fails silently: nothing downstream can tell. We ask whether the output format, a free design choice, controls how often this happens. On the PIZZA ordering benchmark we fine-tune two sub-billion models (Qwen3.5-0.8B and LFM2.5-350M) with LoRA on six lossless encodings of the same target tree, from 44.3 down to 10.9 tokens per order, including two matched-length pairs that vary surface form at fixed length. Across 300 runs (5 training pool sizes, 5 seeds) with a hierarchical bootstrap and Holm correction fixed before the results were read, shortening alone never helps, but writing the target in ordinary words does. The word encoding is the most accurate format on both models (87.5% vs. 85.8% exact match for the native s-expression on Qwen) while emitting 4.1x fewer tokens, and it cuts the silent error rate by 2.3x on Qwen and 1.8x on LFM2, separating at every pool size. Error analysis locates much of the gain in negation. All runs also learn to refuse off-menu input (held out: 95.9-99.0% handled) and to apply in-utterance self-corrections. Strict refusal has a measured price: 2.1-10.1% of real, mostly polite, orders are refused.
items.title_ko: 구문 분석은 되었지만 그럴듯하게 틀린 경우: 출력 형식이 소규모 모델 의미론적 구문 분석의 숨겨진 오류를 제어한다
items.summary_ko: 잘못된 형식의 트리를 생성하는 소규모 미세 조정 파서가 침묵하며 오류를 발생시키는 문제를 다룹니다. 이 연구는 출력 형식이 이러한 '숨겨진 오류' 발생 빈도를 제어하는지 분석하며, PIZZA 주문 벤치마크에서 Qwen3.5-0.8B 및 LFM2.5-350M 모델을 사용하여 6가지 손실 없는 인코딩 방식의 영향을 비교합니다.
items.why_ko: 소규모 LLM의 출력 품질 및 신뢰성 문제를 해결하는 데 중요한 통찰을 제공하며, LLM 기반 시스템에서 '침묵하는 오류'를 줄이기 위한 출력 형식 설계의 중요성을 강조합니다.

items.title: Actor, Judge, or Teacher? Understanding Decision Models in Long-Horizon Agents
items.body: Decision models answer a question with a typed output, such as a choice among options with a probability for each, so one model can choose an agent's actions, evaluate actions already taken, or score every action to teach a policy with reinforcement learning. Prior work has studied them mainly as actors, judging their usefulness by how well they act. We ask whether a decision model that acts poorly can still teach well. We compare three decision models and three general LLMs as actors and judges on ALFWorld, and use JEV as a teacher on ALFWorld and WebShop. As actors, all six models are pulled away from a subgoal that must come first by an easier one. As judges that see the whole trajectory, the same models credit the steps toward that subgoal, and asking whether each action helped, rather than whether the task will succeed, separates useful from useless actions. As a teacher, JEV raises a Qwen2.5-1.5B policy over GRPO from 72.8% to 82.9% success on ALFWorld and from 56.8% to 71.4% on WebShop. These results suggest that a poor actor can still teach well, because judging an action after the episode ends reveals the consequences that acting must anticipate. Code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-REAL/decision-agents.
items.title_ko: 행위자, 심판자 또는 교사? 장기 에이전트의 의사결정 모델 이해
items.summary_ko: 장기 에이전트에서 의사결정 모델이 '행위자(actor)', '심판자(judge)', '교사(teacher)'로서 어떻게 기능하는지 이해하는 연구입니다. 의사결정 모델이 단순히 행동을 선택하는 것을 넘어, 이미 수행된 행동을 평가하거나 정책 학습을 위해 모든 행동에 점수를 부여하는 데 사용될 수 있음을 탐구합니다.
items.why_ko: 복잡한 장기 작업을 수행하는 AI 에이전트의 내부 의사결정 과정을 이해하고 개선하는 데 필수적인 연구로, 에이전트의 자율성과 학습 능력을 향상시키는 데 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Symmetry in Time: A Representation Theory of Linear Recurrent Memory
items.body: State space models (SSMs) are an emerging alternative to Transformers. SSMs offer linear-time inference and parallel training, but most implementations make the parallel scan efficient by making the recurrence diagonal: each channel of the hidden state is multiplied by an input-dependent real or complex number. These numbers commute, so the state records which inputs occurred but not their order. We formalize this with representation theory, which explains and fixes the state-tracking failures previously reported for SSMs. The state update defines a linear representation of the monoid of input sequences, and we show that an SSM tracks a group at every sequence length exactly when that group is a quotient of the group generated by its transition matrices. Two consequences follow. Diagonal real- and complex-valued SSMs can track only commutative groups, while the transition matrices of any SSM that can track a group must split into independent blocks over the real, complex, and quaternion numbers. We then introduce HyperSSM, which adds quaternion channels while keeping linear-time inference and parallel training. Trained only on final answers, HyperSSM solves the group tasks of recent state-tracking benchmarks exactly with at most five state numbers. This includes $S_5$ with 32 generators, where previous SSMs are at chance, and HyperSSM generalizes to sequences 25 times longer than those seen in training. Because the theory says what the transitions must encode, the learned weights of the linear recurrence can be interpreted directly. We demonstrate this by recovering the calibration of a real gyroscope, the rotations of imperfect qubit gates and the geometry of protein backbones.

items.title: Cited but Unused: Parametric Provenance in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.body: Retrieval-augmented generation systems attach citations to attribute claims to their sources. These citations frequently misstate provenance, and standard verification cannot detect this. We measure provenance by counterfactual value substitution: a fact in the retrieved passages is replaced with a false variant and the model re-queried. We find that across five sizes of one model family and a second comparator family, 1.2% to 15.7% of citable claims derive from parametric memory rather than the retrieved context. At the most conservative substitution distance these figures are 4.6% and 8.5% on the two models we tested at it, with the rate rising with model size within a family. We further find that natural language inference verification, the standard approach, gives results indistinguishable from chance across models, even when restricted to the cited passage. We determine that the cause is structural: a model answering from memory selects a citation that agrees with its output. Comparing ten attribution methods on identical claims, the contrast between the model's distribution with and without context best separates provenance. Acting on that signal does not improve provenance honesty at these base rates. The resulting detector is hence still not accurate enough to act on: it measures what the model knew rather than what it used, and separating those remains the open problem.
items.body_ko: 검색 증강 생성 시스템은 출처에 주장을 귀속시키기 위해 인용을 첨부합니다. 이러한 인용은 출처를 잘못 진술하는 경우가 많으며, 표준 검증으로는 이를 감지할 수 없습니다. 우리는 반사실적 값 대체를 통해 출처를 측정합니다. 즉, 검색된 구절의 사실이 거짓 변형으로 대체되고 모델이 다시 쿼리됩니다. 우리는 한 모델 제품군의 5가지 크기와 두 번째 비교 모델 제품군에 걸쳐 인용 가능한 주장의 1.2%에서 15.7%가 검색된 컨텍스트가 아닌 매개변수 메모리에서 파생된다는 것을 발견했습니다. 가장 보수적인 대체 거리에서 이 수치는 우리가 테스트한 두 모델에서 4.6%와 8.5%이며, 제품군 내에서 모델 크기가 커질수록 비율이 증가합니다. 우리는 또한 표준 접근 방식인 자연어 추론 검증이 인용된 구절로 제한될 때조차도 모델 전반에 걸쳐 우연과 구별할 수 없는 결과를 제공한다는 것을 발견했습니다. 우리는 그 원인이 구조적이라고 판단합니다. 즉, 메모리에서 답변하는 모델은 그 출력과 일치하는 인용을 선택합니다. 동일한 주장에 대한 10가지 귀속 방법을 비교했을 때, 컨텍스트 유무에 따른 모델 분포의 대비가 출처를 가장 잘 구분합니다. 그 신호에 따라 행동하는 것은 이러한 기본 비율에서 출처의 정직성을 개선하지 못합니다. 따라서 결과적인 감지기는 여전히 행동할 만큼 충분히 정확하지 않습니다. 그것은 모델이 무엇을 알았는지를 측정하며, 무엇을 사용했는지를 측정하지 못하며, 이들을 분리하는 것이 여전히 열린 문제입니다.
items.title_ko: 인용되었지만 사용되지 않음: 검색 증강 생성의 파라미터 출처
items.summary_ko: 검색 증강 생성(RAG) 시스템에서 인용문이 출처를 잘못 표기하는 문제를 다룹니다. 이 연구는 반사실적 값 대체(counterfactual value substitution)를 통해 모델이 검색된 패시지가 아닌 내부 '파라미터 메모리'에서 정보를 가져오는 경우를 측정합니다. 모델 크기에 따라 1.2%에서 15.7%에 달하는 인용 가능한 주장이 파라미터 메모리에서 유래함을 발견했습니다.
items.why_ko: RAG 시스템의 투명성과 신뢰성 문제를 제기하며, AI 모델의 '환각' 현상과 잘못된 정보 출처 문제를 해결하기 위한 중요한 연구입니다. 이는 개발자들이 RAG 시스템의 신뢰성을 높이는 데 필수적인 고려사항을 제공합니다.

items.title: AeroZoo: A Benchmark of Well-Posed Flow Problems for Foundation Models of Aerodynamics
items.body: Neural surrogates for computational fluid dynamics (CFD) are trained and ranked on datasets that each vary one design family in one flow domain. Such datasets cannot test the least that an aerodynamic foundation model must do: predict CFD-quality incompressible flow in seconds for new shapes in new enclosures. On DrivAerML, larger models and longer training barely lower Transolver's error; doubling the training cases cuts it by about 12% up to 400 cases, exhausting the dataset. We introduce AeroZoo, a benchmark and training corpus of 3,815 time-mean solutions to the unsteady Reynolds-averaged Navier--Stokes (RANS) equations with a transition model, across seven geometry families, eight enclosure configurations and Reynolds numbers from $10^3$ to $10^8$. Each sample poses a well-posed PDE problem in the form a solver receives it: the boundary meshes grouped by condition type, the prescribed values and the fluid properties. The 2,816 samples with a stable time mean form the canonical benchmark: two tasks, engineering metrics and 22 frozen splits, disjoint in geometry, that hold out geometry families, enclosures, boundary-condition layouts and Reynolds ranges. On the random split, boundary-condition tokens cut GeoTransolver's median velocity error from 76.9% to 8.4% of the inlet speed in single-seed runs (uniform inlet flow: 11.0%). ISLA, a transformer for boundary-driven PDEs, reaches 5.3% over four seeds, about 4 times the change from a finer mesh. On the same test samples, a held-out geometry family barely changes ISLA's error relative to uniform flow, and a held-out enclosure or boundary-condition layout raises it 2.4 to 9.2 times. The data and the scoring code will be released.
items.title_ko: AeroZoo: 공기역학 파운데이션 모델을 위한 잘 정의된 유동 문제 벤치마크
items.summary_ko: 기존 CFD(전산 유체 역학) 신경망 대체 모델 벤치마크의 한계를 지적하며, 새로운 형태와 환경에 대한 CFD 품질의 비압축성 유동을 몇 초 안에 예측할 수 있는 공기역학 파운데이션 모델을 위한 'AeroZoo' 벤치마크를 소개합니다.
items.why_ko: 공기역학 분야의 AI 파운데이션 모델 개발 및 평가를 위한 표준화된 벤치마크를 제공하여, AI를 활용한 항공우주 및 공학 설계의 발전을 가속화할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Enhancing Preference Detection using Eye Movement Cascade and Multilayer Combinatorial Fusion
items.body: Understanding how visual attention influences human preference formation is a fundamental problem in consumer behavior and cognitive science. In this work, we investigate how eye movement patterns can be used to predict preference decisions when subjects compare two alternatives. To address this problem, we analyze an eye-tracking dataset, where subjects view pairs of face images and their gaze behavior is recorded throughout the decision process. We model this problem using multiple machine learning classifiers and apply the Multi-layer Combinatorial Fusion (MCF) framework to iteratively combine diverse models. The MCF framework expands models to a large pool of model fusions and then reduces them based on cognitive diversity, repeating this process across layers until diversity diminishes. Experimental results show that MCF significantly improves performance over individual models. The best single model achieves a Pre@k of 0.90, which is improved to 0.9143 after the first layer of MCF, and further increased to 0.9286 in the second layer. This progression demonstrates that the second layer not only surpasses the performance of the first layer but also outperforms the best individual model, highlighting the effectiveness of leveraging diversity through multi-layer fusion.
items.title_ko: 안구 운동 캐스케이드 및 다층 조합 융합을 이용한 선호도 탐지 강화
items.summary_ko: 인간의 시각적 주의가 선호도 형성에 미치는 영향을 이해하기 위해, 두 대안을 비교할 때의 안구 운동 패턴을 사용하여 선호도 결정을 예측하는 방법을 연구합니다. 얼굴 이미지 쌍 데이터셋을 분석하여 다중 기계 학습 모델을 사용한 접근 방식을 제안합니다.
